layout.note: Dynamically growing tree. Each played tile becomes a node. Edges connect matching ends. Doubles create chickenfoot branch points (3 arms).

score.note: Running pip-count penalty score across rounds. Lowest wins.

tile.note: Double-nine domino set: 55 unique tiles from [0,0] to [9,9].

phases.name: deal
phases.note: Server shuffles boneyard and deals tiles (count depends on player count: 2p=21, 3p=14, 4p=11, 5-6p=9, 7-8p=7).

phases.name: open
phases.note: Player with the round's target double (9-9 first round, then 8-8, etc.) plays it as the center node. If nobody has it, draw until found.

phases.name: fill_arms
phases.note: Players must play on the 4 arms of the center double before playing elsewhere. Each arm requires a tile matching the center double's value.

phases.name: play
phases.note: Normal play: place a tile matching any open end. If a double is played, it creates a chickenfoot — 3 tiles must be played on it before any other end.

center_double.definition: Each round begins with a specific double placed in the center. Round 1: double-9, round 2: double-8, etc. The center has 4 open arms.

chickenfoot.definition: When a double is played (other than the center), it creates a chickenfoot: 3 new arms branch from it. All 3 arms must be filled before any player may play on other open ends.
chickenfoot.constraint: If a chickenfoot is open (fewer than 3 tiles played on it), all plays must target that chickenfoot.
chickenfoot.note: The branching shape resembles a chicken's foot — hence the name.

play_tile.definition: Place a tile from hand onto an open end of the layout. One half must match the open end value.
constraints: tile is in current player hand
matching half connects to open end

draw.definition: If no tile in hand matches any playable end, draw one tile from the boneyard. If the drawn tile is playable, it may be played immediately. If boneyard is empty, pass.

scoring.definition: When a round ends, each player's remaining pip count is added to their running score. The center double player scores 0 for that round if they went out.
scoring.note: Lowest cumulative score after all 10 rounds wins.

notation.note: Tiles written as 'a-b' (e.g., '5-3'). Doubles written as 'a=a' (e.g., '7=7').
